portable_entry_requirements: Keep evidence/raw firmware hashes and range checks before compile.
Resolve dependency files relative to explicit published root/suite root, not cwd or private Windows paths.
Host tests use CC/CXX on Unix; MSVC on Windows can be entered without PowerShell.
RV32 compile/ELF validation is a distinct gate; host test success cannot replace it.
Preserve original executable argv: repo root vs Runtime/BOOT vs zero args vs explicit Firmware/ProofRoot.
Source/test literal mappings may be incomplete for dynamically assembled PowerShell paths; retain original line evidence and review before enabling a suite.
Version-specific firmware hashes must remain separate: legacy Runtime32639d7d and V4.1.60 Runtime0ee64183.
